digest.component_or_area: Container plan-review attestation and manifest inheritance
propositions: A live declared-none child must be neutral in scope inheritance and not poison sibling path declarations or force whole-HEAD invalidation
Live undeclared children must poison child inheritance and prevent promotion to all-none scope, while live none children do not
Parent-owned paths take dependency precedence over all-none children and the manifest must sign parent path dependencies without synthesizing a file-scope:none marker
Cheap resign via resign_plan_review must preserve the same child-derived signed scope using immutable relation snapshot without network reads
P9 must pass declared-none leaves and containers with all-declared live children, while advising only on live undeclared children as poisoners with path-declaration and --none remedies
